obstructions.statement: Construct a single compatible all-Artin-order tower for the fixed denominator-cleared signed rational witness in the exact witness category, preserving the intended class/interface; independent per-order lifts do not suffice.
obstructions.falsifier: Reject any purported solution consisting only of first-order tangent surjectivity, obstruction vanishing without compatibility, or separately chosen n-th order lifts.

obstructions.statement: Given an effective exact witness over the completed local Hodge branch, obtain a source-bound descent/spread to an actual henselian/etale/Zariski branch neighborhood with coefficient, component and class identity preserved.
obstructions.falsifier: Reject any argument that treats an object over Spec(completed local ring) as already giving witnesses on nearby complex points of the original branch.

obstructions.statement: Verify that the algebraized componentwise closed subschemes satisfy the exact Hilbert/Chow flatness/cycle interface and that the resulting signed rational cycle represents the prescribed flat class alpha.
obstructions.falsifier: Reject fixed coefficient bookkeeping alone as a proof of Gauss-Manin class identity or flat Hilbert membership.

closed_scoped_obligation.scope: only after the compatible closed-subscheme tower and proper special fibre are supplied; no descent or root authority
